title: pf-step-result/1
description: The result file a step script writes (--out, the same document on stdout with --json): one JSON object, written atomically. The verdict is the exit code's and nothing else. The workflow contract's Scripts section (docs/reference/workflow-contract.md) is the rule; a script writes it with pfstep/result.py.

command.description: The command or script that ran.

version.description: The build of the command that ran.

argv.description: Its arguments as given, the name excluded.

round.description: PF_ROUND as the step environment carried it (empty outside a step): a later step reuses a result only from its own round.

exit_code.description: The exit code the command ended with.

verdict.description: The exit code's verdict: 0 pass, 1 fail, 3 partial, any other error.

heads.description: The HEAD commit of every repository the command ran in (repo name to sha).

summary.description: One line: the fail reason's head on a fail, the incomplete reason on an error.

details.description: The command's own record (its shape is the command's).

logs.description: The log files it wrote, relative to the capsule root when inside it.
